messages:
Ivy (SRE): Quick follow-up from the postmortem: we need owners for public status copy, gated-RCA flow, and recurring-pattern remediation. Short thread, please confirm owners.

Rohan (Ops): I can draft the status copy and the 72h summary. Will post v1 by tomorrow morning.

Leah (Product): Keep public copy non-technical. Add a clear 'do I need to act' line.

Sam (Support): I'll pull affected-customer list and prepare outbound templates. Need final copy by tomorrow 2pm.

Ivy (SRE): Proposal: public summary on status page + detailed RCA available on request for customers. Ops to field requests and log them.

Leah (Product): +1. Add a 5 business day SLA for RCA requests in the FAQ.

Rohan (Ops) (status draft):
```
What happened
A cache eviction configuration update on Mar 23 caused a brief latency spike for a small subset of requests between 02:10-02:40 UTC.

Impact
Approximately 3% of requests experienced higher latency. No customer data exposure.

What we did
We reverted the configuration update and deployed a patch to the eviction heuristic. Enhanced monitoring is in place.

Next steps
A summarized timeline will be posted here. Customers who need a detailed technical RCA can request it via support; we aim to respond within 5 business days.
```

Sam (Support): Gated-RCA flow: Support triages -> Ops verifies request -> escalate to Product/Eng for account-specific follow-up. I'll add templates and flag enterprise tenants.

Ivy (SRE): Owners & deadlines: status + 72h: Rohan (Ops) - 1 business day; outbound messages: Sam (Support) - tomorrow 2pm; fix + tests: Ivy (SRE) - 10 business days; systemic review: Leah (Product) + Ivy - schedule in 2 weeks.

postmortem-bot: Action items recorded: PM-5100. Link: https://internal.redwood/postmortems/PM-5100

Leah (Product): Sounds good. Please add 'what this means for you: no action required' to the customer text.

Rohan (Ops): Will update draft and post final. Thanks all.
